Are bought-Stage prices right at 180 gold for IV and 135,000 for X? Every other price scales from those two. A wyrm core at 20,000 gold and up follows from the same table.
Keep the Accord's split into signed and sworn members? It is the biggest invented structure on the Accord shelf, along with the Sitting of Halls and free companies escaping the Law of Reversal.
Does a Typology doubled by a Wellspring move anything on the sheet? As written it leaves the Grade alone and changes the character of the blow.
Are windows incomplete by design? As written they report only what the soul has felt, so Garrick's window misses his spleen.

Can a soul refuse a class? As written an unanswered offer keeps the old name at the new tier and waits. Can a bought Catalyst override a Coherence fault, and if Hataraki removes a blessing that gave a Stage, does the Stage stay? As written the Crystal is left built to a shape it never earned, and most survive but few fight again.

Should Nalūn stay? The brief says it is gone as a state, but KINGDOMS.md and the staged pages keep the Amber Cities of Nalūn as free cities with no crown. I left it as free cities. Anguz survives only as dead mines.
